decks.notes: The main concept behind this deck is to play aggressively with the Canadian Threshold archetype, utilizing powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while also disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game with cheap spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, while also applying pressure with burn spells like Lightning Bolt. Additionally, the deck includes land disruption with Wasteland and card draw with Mishra's Bauble to maintain advantage throughout the match.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with an aggressive swarm of Goblin creatures. By utilizing powerful Goblin lords like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Battle Cry Goblin, along with mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, it aims to flood the board with threats early in the game. The inclusion of disruption cards like Chalice of the Void and Cavern of Souls helps protect the Goblin army from opposing spells, while cards like Shatterskull Smashing provide removal options. The deck benefits from a fast and explosive playstyle to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

This control deck focuses on using a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game. It also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. The deck includes cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board control. With a mix of lands for consistency and various win conditions like Terminus and Leyline Binding, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through strategic play and resource management.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Grief to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Baleful Strix provides card advantage while Troll of Khazad-dûm and other creatures serve as win conditions. The deck also includes land destruction with Wasteland and versatile planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler for additional control. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently reanimating threats and controlling the game to secure victory.

This combo-reanimator deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption like Unmask and Daze to protect the combo, as well as card filtering with Careful Study. The key strategy is to cheat out big threats early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures before they have a chance to respond.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, along with disruptive cards like Stifle and Dress Down. The main win condition is Phyrexian Dreadnought, which is combined with Doorkeeper Thrull to provide a powerful threat. The deck also includes cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Swords to Plowshares for additional versatility and removal. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of spells. The overall strategy is to control the opponent's actions while setting up a quick and efficient win condition.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to quickly ramp into powerful threats while hindering the opponent's ability to cast spells effectively. By controlling the game through disruption and aggression, Dragon Stompy seeks to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory before they can establish their own game plan.

Utilize fast mana and graveyard manipulation to cheat powerful creatures into play quickly, disrupting the opponent's hand and board state. Win the game by overwhelming the opponent with large threats like Archon of Cruelty, Griselbrand, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. Take advantage of the combo potential of cards like Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate to bring back creatures from the graveyard and swing the game in your favor.

This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt opponents while utilizing the Stifle and Phyrexian Dreadnought combo for a powerful win condition. The deck includes a mix of counterspells, removal, card draw, and disruptive creatures to control the game and protect the combo. The key strategy is to slow down opponents with counterspells and removal while setting up the Stiflenought combo for a quick and unexpected victory. The combination of control elements and a powerful win condition makes this deck a formidable force in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

Utilize efficient reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. Use cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up your graveyard and find your combo pieces. Control the game with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, while keeping your opponent's resources in check with Wasteland. With a mix of reanimation, disruption, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures such as Grief and Archon of Cruelty, then using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for a powerful combo. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and control the game. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while controlling the game with countermagic and disruption, leading to a swift victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent through aggressive creature plays such as Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland and Force of Will. The deck also aims to maintain card advantage and deck manipulation through cards like Ponder, Mishra's Bauble, and Brainstorm. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Stifle and Brazen Borrower allows for further disruption and flexibility in gameplay. Overall, the deck seeks to control the pace of the game and outpace the opponent with quick and versatile threats.

The deck aims to quickly get big creatures into the graveyard using cards like Grief, Thoughtseize, and Entomb, then use spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. The deck also has cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to help accelerate the combo. Using a mix of disruption, discard spells, and reanimation, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty. The deck is focused on fast, explosive plays to close out games before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main concept of this aggro Goblins deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Goblin creatures that can quickly deal damage and overrun the opponent. The deck includes powerful Goblin creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Muxus, Goblin Grandee, as well as cards like City of Traitors and Chrome Mox to ramp up mana quickly. By playing aggressively and utilizing cards like Legion Warboss and Goblin Ringleader to generate tokens and draw cards, the deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It utilizes powerful interaction like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's game plan while digging for answers with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck also includes cards like Leyline Binding and Dress Down to handle threats on the board. The goal is to out-value and outlast the opponent by efficiently managing resources and controlling the pace of the game.

The main focus of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Goblins deck is to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive strategy, utilizing powerful Goblin creatures like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Rabblemaster. The deck also includes mana acceleration cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to help cast these threats early on. With a mix of disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to apply pressure quickly and efficiently, taking advantage of synergies within the Goblin tribe to outpace the opponent and claim victory.
